Noa (Docs): Heads-up: docs examples will start including the new `response_schema` parameter for structured outputs. Please align SDK samples.
Eli (SDK): Is this changing runtime?
Noa (Docs): Docs-first. Runtime still supports old freeform responses. `response_schema` is a documentation and helper param that instructs SDKs to parse/validate outputs and emit telemetry.
Rhea (Eng): Backend will accept `response_schema` metadata and forward to validation hooks. No break.
Marta (Product): Timeline: docs live now, SDK sample updates this sprint, minor SDKs next week, full documentation migration in 6 weeks.
Eli (SDK): We'll add parsing helpers and example snippets in js/py/go. Also include a note about opt-in default — SDK will default to no validation unless user sets `response_schema` to avoid surprise errors.
Noa (Docs): Canonical example added: 
```
# example
resp = client.generate(
  model="r-struct-001",
  input="Summarize the release notes in one paragraph",
  response_schema={"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}}
)
print(resp.parsed.summary)
```
Eli (SDK): Will open PRs and include migration FAQ.
